title: Baba Ke Liye Roti Hai Yu Fatima Sughra suna hai madina
body:
Suna Hai Madina Suna Hai Madina
baba Ke Liye Roti Hai Yu Fatima Sughra
01. Ghar Chod Gaye Hai Mera Dil Tod Gaye Hai
ghar Waale Nahi Ghar Me To Ab Kahe Ka Jeena
<<DIVIDER>>
02. Beemar Ko Hamraah Jo Lejate Baradar
rehti Mai Kaneezi Me Jo Kehdeti Sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
03. Kunbe Se Juda Hone Se Ye Haal Huwa Hai
che Saala Zaeefa Mujhe Kehta Hai Zamana
<<DIVIDER>>
04. Asghar Bhi Nahi Kaise Dil Behlaaye Gi Sughra
hai Kaam Mera Khaali Ek Jhule Ko Jhulana
<<DIVIDER>>
05. Ye Chaand Muharram Ka Q Rulwata Hai Mujhko
dil Doobta Jata Hai Ye Kaisa Hai Mahina
